It has a hippogryph roost and gives access to the Blade's Edge Mountains to the north, and its inhabitants are humble and hopeful.

3818.name: Bloodscale Grounds
3818.description: The Bloodscale Grounds are a naga-infested region by the eastern shore of Serpent Lake in northern Zangarmarsh. The naga guard the approaches to Coilfang Reservoir.

3819.name: Darkcrest Enclave
3819.description: The Darkcrest Enclave is a naga-infested region in Zangarmarsh, southeast of the Lagoon. The naga here serve Illidan's armies and guard their territory fiercely.

3841.name: Darkcrest Shore
3841.description: The Darkcrest Shore is a naga-infested stretch of shore in Zangarmarsh, west of Umbrafen Lake. The naga have built camps along the water.

3895.name: Cenarion Watchpost
3895.description: The Cenarion Watchpost is a small camp of the Cenarion Expedition in southwestern Zangarmarsh, home to a single druid and her companion, who watch over the sporelings of the marsh. It is a quiet, secluded place.

3905.name: Coilfang Reservoir
3905.description: Coilfang Reservoir is a vast pumping station built by the naga beneath Serpent Lake in northern Zangarmarsh, a compound of gigantic caverns punctured by massive pipes and pistons, powered by titanic crystal capacitors, and big enough to house armies. Its entrance lies beneath the cold waters of the lake. It is the stronghold of Lady Vashj and her naga, servants of Illidan: in the Slave Pens, Broken draenei toil as slaves; in the Underbog, the exotic flora and fauna of the marsh grow wild; and in the Steamvault, the naga's arcane machinery drains the waters of Zangarmarsh, threatening to destroy the entire marsh.

3521.description: Zangarmarsh is a hauntingly beautiful swamp in western Outland, covered by a forest of giant mushrooms that tower above its many lakes and pools like great trees. It is a land of soft, phosphorescent light, where glowing fungi, luminous spores, and bioluminescent creatures fill the eternal twilight with blue and green hues. Bordered by mountains to the north, south, and east and by the sea to the west, the marsh largely evaded the demonic corruption that ravaged the rest of Draenor, and its waters remained clean. It is said that the Prophet Velen and his surviving followers hid here after the orcs' slaughter of the draenei. In recent times, however, the marsh's self-contained ecology has begun to falter: the naga of Lady Vashj, servants of Illidan, have built great pumps in Coilfang Reservoir that are draining the waters, and the Ango'rosh ogres are cutting down the giant mushrooms. The mushrooms are dying, and so are the creatures that depend on them. The Cenarion Expedition, an offshoot of the Cenarion Circle, works to protect the marsh from its base at Cenarion Refuge. The draenei hold the mushroom-top fortress of Telredor, the Kurenai Broken hold Orebor Harborage, and the trolls of the Horde hold Zabra'jin. The peaceful sporelings, a race of sapient fungi, dwell at Sporeggar in the west, while Lost Ones, fungal giants, bog lords, and spore bats roam the marsh.

3522.name: Blade's Edge Mountains

3767.name: Blades' Run
3767.description: Blades' Run is a sloping ridge leading down from a cave south of the Jagged Ridge in the southern Blade's Edge Mountains to northeastern Zangarmarsh, a path between the jagged peaks and the luminous marsh below.

3768.name: Jagged Ridge
3768.description: The Jagged Ridge is a wooded region in the southern Blade's Edge Mountains, south of Thunderlord Stronghold and west of Razor Ridge. It is inhabited by wolves and chimaeras, and its tall trees cling to the steep slopes.

3769.name: Thunderlord Stronghold
3769.description: Thunderlord Stronghold is a Horde town in the Blade's Edge Mountains, once the stronghold of the Thunderlord clan of orcs. When the clan was transformed into fel orcs, the stronghold was abandoned, and the ogres of the Bladespire clan later took over its ruins, until Horde forces drove them out and claimed it in honor of the original clan. It was here that the hero Rexxar came in search of his own people after the Dark Portal reopened. An old orcish town hall stands at its center, protected by walls and Mag'har watch towers, and the dire wolves the Horde brought from Azeroth have made their den nearby. Its warriors stand watch against the ogres and the Legion.

3770.name: Blade Tooth Canyon
3770.description: Blade Tooth Canyon is a sloping ridge leading down from a cave south of the Living Grove in the southwestern Blade's Edge Mountains to Orebor Harborage in Zangarmarsh. The path winds between steep rocks.

3771.name: The Living Grove
3771.description: The Living Grove is a wooded region of the southwestern Blade's Edge Mountains, home to the night elf town of Sylvanaar and the arakkoa settlement of Veil Lashh. Lynxes, faerie dragons, and treants roam its green slopes, and night elf Sentinels guard it.

3772.name: Sylvanaar
3772.description: Sylvanaar is a night elf settlement in the Living Grove of the Blade's Edge Mountains, overlooking the expansive Bloodmaul Ravine below. Its graceful buildings, two moonwells, and tall trees make it a peaceful refuge amid the harsh mountains. It has an inn and a hippogryph roost, and its Sentinels keep watch over the ogres below.

3773.name: Bladespire Hold
3773.description: Bladespire Hold is the home of the Bladespire clan of ogres, on the western side of the central valley of the Blade's Edge Mountains. The Bladespire are locked in a constant war with the Bloodmaul clan, each seeking the favor of their gronn masters. The hold is a crude fortress of stone and timber.

3774.name: Gruul's Lair
3774.description: Gruul's Lair is a great cavern in the northern Blade's Edge Mountains, the lair of Gruul the Dragonkiller, the merciless gronn overlord who rules over the ogres of the region. Gruul earned his name by slaying many dragons, whose bones hang impaled on the peaks nearby. The lair is guarded by his ogre servants, led by their high king, and few who enter return.

3775.name: Circle of Blood
3775.description: The Circle of Blood is a large ogre structure in Daggermaw Canyon in the Blade's Edge Mountains, just northwest of Dragons' End. It holds a great arena where fighters battle for glory before crowds.

3776.name: Bloodmaul Outpost
3776.description: Bloodmaul Outpost is an outpost of the Bloodmaul clan of ogres at the southern end of the Bloodmaul Ravine in the central Blade's Edge Mountains. A troll witch doctor taught these ogres to brew a potent beer, which they now distribute to other ogre settlements, and they repaid him poorly. The Bladespire clan constantly sends skirmishers against them.

3777.name: Bloodmaul Camp
3777.description: Bloodmaul Camp is the main encampment of the Bloodmaul ogres in the Blade's Edge Mountains, at the northern edge of Daggermaw Canyon to the southwest of Gruul's Lair. The ogres here serve the gronn and attack anyone who comes near.

3778.name: Draenethyst Mine
3778.description: The Draenethyst Mine is a small ogre-controlled dig site in the southern Blade's Edge Mountains, rich in draenethyst crystals. The Explorers' League has taken an interest in the mine and its crystals.

3779.name: Trogma's Claim
3779.description: Trogma's Claim is a cave in the southeastern Blade's Edge Mountains, held by the Vekh'nir arakkoa. It is riddled with draenethyst crystals, which are mined by enslaved ogres under the watchful eyes of the arakkoa and their leader.

3780.name: Blackwing Coven
3780.description: The Blackwing Coven is a cave in Raven's Wood in the northwestern Blade's Edge Mountains, controlled by the Wyrmcult, cultists who serve the black dragonflight. Dark rituals are performed within.

3781.name: Grishnath
3781.description: Grishnath is an arakkoa settlement in Raven's Wood in the northwestern Blade's Edge Mountains. Its nests and huts are built among the dark trees, and the arakkoa who dwell there practice dark magic.

3782.name: Veil Lashh
3782.description: Veil Lashh is an arakkoa settlement in the southwestern Blade's Edge Mountains, surrounded by the Living Grove just south of Sylvanaar. The arakkoa here are hostile to outsiders.

3783.name: Veil Vekh
3783.description: Veil Vekh is an arakkoa settlement in the southern part of Vekhaar Stand in the Blade's Edge Mountains, home to the Vekh'nir tribe.

3784.name: Forge Camp: Terror
3784.description: Forge Camp: Terror is one of the three Burning Legion forge camps in the Blade's Edge Mountains, high on a plateau south of Ogri'la, reachable only from the air. Emplacements of fel flak cannons guard it against the Sha'tari Skyguard and anyone else who might attack from the sky, and demons forge weapons within.

3785.name: Forge Camp: Wrath
3785.description: Forge Camp: Wrath is the northernmost of the three Burning Legion forge camps in the Blade's Edge Mountains, high on a plateau north of Ogri'la and northwest of Bladespire Hold, reachable only from the air. Emplacements of fel flak cannons guard it against the Sha'tari Skyguard and anyone else who might attack from the sky.

3786.name: Ogri'la
3786.description: Ogri'la is a community of ogres on a high plateau in the western Blade's Edge Mountains who have transcended their brutish nature and the domination of the gronn to achieve enlightenment, aided by the mysterious power of the apexis crystals. The ogres of Ogri'la are wise and peaceful by ogre standards, and they battle the Burning Legion and the black dragonflight, who seek the crystals for themselves. Other ogres speak of Ogri'la as a kind of promised land. The Sha'tari Skyguard aid the ogres in their struggle.

3787.name: Forge Camp: Anger
3787.description: Forge Camp: Anger is one of the three Burning Legion forge camps in the Blade's Edge Mountains, located south of Bladed Gulch in the northeast. Its forges burn with fel fire.

3824.name: Bloodmaul Ravine
3824.description: Bloodmaul Ravine is a ravine at the southern end of the central valley of the Blade's Edge Mountains, southeast of Sylvanaar and west of Thunderlord Stronghold. It is home to the Bloodmaul ogres and their outpost.

3825.name: Dragons' End
3825.description: Dragons' End is a cleft leading from Daggermaw Canyon to Cursed Hollow in the central Blade's Edge Mountains, named for the four gigantic black dragons impaled on its jagged peaks, presumably slain by the gronn. Their huge skeletons are a grim sight.

3826.name: Daggermaw Canyon
3826.description: Daggermaw Canyon is a long chasm in the Blade's Edge Mountains leading south from Gruul's Lair, past Bloodmaul Camp, the Circle of Blood, and Churning Gulch, to the Bladespire Grounds and Bloodmaul Ravine. It is named for the Daggermaw raptors that roam it, though ogres hold a strong presence throughout.

3827.name: Vekhaar Stand
3827.description: Vekhaar Stand is a forested glade in the southeastern Blade's Edge Mountains, home to the Mok'Nathal Village and the arakkoa of Veil Vekh. Two caves open into Trogma's Claim and Death's Door.

3828.name: Ruuan Weald
3828.description: Ruuan Weald is a forested glade in the eastern Blade's Edge Mountains, home to the Cenarion Expedition's outpost of Evergrove and the arakkoa of Veil Ruuan. It is patrolled by members of the Wyrmcult, servants of the black dragonflight.

3829.name: Veil Ruuan
3829.description: Veil Ruuan is an arakkoa settlement in the northern part of Ruuan Weald in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

3830.name: Raven's Wood
3830.description: Raven's Wood is a dark forest in the northwestern Blade's Edge Mountains, home to the arakkoa of Grishnath, the ogres of Boulder'mok, and the Wyrmcult's Blackwing Coven. It is roamed by aggressive ancients and ravens.

3831.name: Death's Door
3831.description: Death's Door is a great valley, likely once a volcanic crater, between the Jagged Ridge and Vekhaar Stand in the southeastern Blade's Edge Mountains. It holds one of the dimensional gateways that the Burning Legion once used to bring demons into Outland. Illidan's forces shut down the other gates, but this one is still partially functional, kept alive by an eredar houndmaster who uses his own magic to draw wrath hounds through it as reinforcements for the Legion's forge camps. Beholders and other demons guard the area.

3832.name: Vortex Pinnacle
3832.description: Vortex Pinnacle is an expansive ridge in the western Blade's Edge Mountains, west of Sylvanaar and Bladespire Hold, reachable mainly from the air. It is roamed by scorpids, colossi, and warp stalkers, and it is home to the enlightened ogres of Ogri'la, while black dragons circle above its perches.

3833.name: Razor Ridge
3833.description: Razor Ridge is an area near Toshley's Station in the eastern Blade's Edge Mountains, crawling with ravagers. An ogre camp stands among its rocks.

3844.name: Mok'Nathal Village
3844.description: Mok'Nathal Village is a settlement in the eastern Blade's Edge Mountains, just north of Vekhaar Stand, inhabited by the Mok'Nathal, a clan of ogres, orcs, and half-ogres of brownish hue who wear distinctive shoulder armor and keep tame clefthooves. The hero Rexxar belongs to this clan, and his father, Leoroxx, dwells here. The village has an inn, a watch tower, and a wind rider roost, and its people are friendly to the Horde.

3855.name: Circle of Blood Arena
3855.description: The Circle of Blood Arena is an ogre-built arena in the Blade's Edge Mountains, north of Thunderlord Stronghold, where gladiators of all races battle across a bridge and ramps above a pit ringed with wooden spikes, for gold and glory before cheering crowds.

3862.name: Churning Gulch
3862.description: Churning Gulch is a jagged cleft near Daggermaw Canyon in the central Blade's Edge Mountains, crawling with sand worms that burst from the earth to attack their prey.

3863.name: Broken Wilds
3863.description: The Broken Wilds are a sloping ridge leading down from Skald in the northeastern Blade's Edge Mountains to the Gyro-Plank Bridge and Netherstorm beyond.

3864.name: Bash'ir Landing
3864.description: Bash'ir Landing is a camp of ethereals in the northern Blade's Edge Mountains, reachable only from the air. A crystal forge stands here, and the Sha'tari Skyguard regularly assault the area.

3865.name: Crystal Spine
3865.description: The Crystal Spine is an area in the northern Blade's Edge Mountains, home to nether drakes and other creatures, full of beautiful crystals that give it its name. It is reachable mainly from the air.

3866.name: Skald
3866.description: Skald is a scorched area in the Bladed Gulch in the northeastern Blade's Edge Mountains, just east of Gruul's Lair. It was once a wooded region, but fire elementals and their imps moved in and burned everything to cinders. The elementals roam the area and attack anyone who comes near.

3867.name: Bladed Gulch
3867.description: Bladed Gulch is an expansive ridge in the northeastern Blade's Edge Mountains, north of Razaan's Landing and Forge Camp: Anger, leading north to Skald and the Broken Wilds. It is roamed by wind serpents, raptors, and cultists of the Shadow Council.

3903.name: Boulder'mok
3903.description: Boulder'mok is an ogre settlement in Raven's Wood in the northwestern Blade's Edge Mountains, a crude camp among the dark trees.

3904.name: Cursed Hollow
3904.description: Cursed Hollow is a hollow northeast of Dragons' End in the central Blade's Edge Mountains, the home of one of the gronn, the giant masters of the ogres.

3918.name: Toshley's Station
3918.description: Toshley's Station is a gnomish Alliance village in the Blade's Edge Mountains, where gnomes perform their most daring experiments. The gnomes once lived in Sylvanaar until the night elves asked them to leave because of their noisy machines. The station is a cluttered place of workshops, contraptions, and explosions, and a gryphon roost connects it with other Alliance holdings.

3919.name: Singing Ridge
3919.description: Singing Ridge is an area of the southeastern Blade's Edge Mountains, home to nether drakes and rock flayers, full of beautiful crystals that resonate with a soft frequency, giving the ridge its name.

3922.name: Bladespire Outpost
3922.description: Bladespire Outpost is an ogre camp on Razor Ridge north of Toshley's Station in the Blade's Edge Mountains, held by the Bladespire clan.

3924.name: Northmaul Tower
3924.description: Northmaul Tower is an ogre-controlled tower in Bloodmaul Outpost in the southern Blade's Edge Mountains.

3925.name: Southmaul Tower
3925.description: Southmaul Tower is an ogre-controlled tower in Bloodmaul Outpost in the southern Blade's Edge Mountains.

3931.name: Bladespire Grounds
3931.description: The Bladespire Grounds are an area of the central Blade's Edge Mountains, home to the Bladespire clan of ogres.

3942.name: Razaan's Landing
3942.description: Razaan's Landing is a camp of hostile ethereals in Bladed Gulch in the eastern Blade's Edge Mountains, filled with floating orbs made of mana and soul matter. Fleshbeasts crawl across the ground, and the ethereals attack anyone on sight.

3951.name: Evergrove
3951.description: Evergrove is an outpost of the Cenarion Expedition in Ruuan Weald in the Blade's Edge Mountains, manned almost entirely by night elves. It welcomes members of both the Alliance and the Horde, and its druids work to protect the mountains from the Legion, the black dragonflight, and other threats.

3952.name: Wyrmskull Bridge
3952.description: The Wyrmskull Bridge is an overpass in the Blade's Edge Mountains crossing Daggermaw Canyon, connecting Ruuan Weald with Raven's Wood, controlled by the Cenarion Expedition.

3953.name: Scalewing Shelf
3953.description: Scalewing Shelf is an area of the southeastern Blade's Edge Mountains, home to many wind serpents and raptors.

3954.name: Wyrmskull Tunnel
3954.description: The Wyrmskull Tunnel is a passage between the Wyrmskull Bridge and Raven's Wood in the northwestern Blade's Edge Mountains, controlled by the Wyrmcult. Its walls are dark and its passages dangerous.

3960.name: Soulgrinder's Barrow
3960.description: Soulgrinder's Barrow is a dark lair just south of the entrance to Gruul's Lair in the Blade's Edge Mountains, said to be the home of one of the sons of Gruul.

3962.name: Vim'gol's Circle
3962.description: Vim'gol's Circle is a dark place in the northeastern Blade's Edge Mountains, just before the entrance to Netherstorm, marked by five circles of fire. It is said to be the home of a vile ogre sorcerer.

3963.name: Dragonspine Ridge
3963.description: Dragonspine Ridge is the towering, spiny mountain ridge separating the northeastern and central Blade's Edge Mountains, pierced by the Wyrmskull Tunnel.

3964.name: Skyguard Outpost
3964.description: Skyguard Outpost is a small outpost of the Sha'tari Skyguard on the western cliffs of the Blade's Edge Mountains, near Ogri'la. The Skyguard's nether ray riders aid the enlightened ogres against the Legion and the black dragonflight.

3969.name: Rivendark's Perch
3969.description: Rivendark's Perch is the lair of a great black dragon who circles above the Vortex Pinnacle in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

3970.name: Obsidia's Perch
3970.description: Obsidia's Perch is the lair of a great black dragon who circles above the Vortex Pinnacle in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

3971.name: Insidion's Perch
3971.description: Insidion's Perch is the lair of a great black dragon who circles above the Crystal Spine in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

3972.name: Furywing's Perch
3972.description: Furywing's Perch is the lair of a great black dragon who circles above the Crystal Spine in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

4008.name: Shartuul's Transporter
4008.description: Shartuul's Transporter is a demonic teleportation device just south of Forge Camp: Wrath in the Blade's Edge Mountains, firmly under the control of the Burning Legion. Fel energy crackles around it.

3522.description: The Blade's Edge Mountains are a region of knife-sharp crags and axe-cut valleys in northern Outland, lying north of Zangarmarsh and west of Netherstorm. Over the ages, the harsh winds ripping through the canyons have worn the escarpments into menacing, dagger-like spikes that give the region its name, and the green glow of the Twisting Nether shimmers in the sky above. The land combines rocky valleys, forested slopes, and barren plateau summits, and it is home to rock flayers, ravagers, wind serpents, nether drakes, and a substantial population of ogres. The mountains are the homeland of the brutish ogres of the Bladespire and Bloodmaul clans, who wage constant, fierce battles against one another to win the favor of their merciless masters, the gronn, giant creatures ruled by Gruul the Dragonkiller from his lair in the north. The bones of great black dragons slain by the gronn hang impaled on the jagged peaks. The Burning Legion has built forge camps on the high plateaus, the black dragonflight and its cultists lurk in the north, and arakkoa dwell in the forests. Yet there is hope here too: the night elves hold Sylvanaar, the gnomes Toshley's Station, the Horde Thunderlord Stronghold and the Mok'Nathal village, the Cenarion Expedition Evergrove, and on the western plateau, the enlightened ogres of Ogri'la have transcended their brutish nature with the help of mysterious crystals.

3523.name: Netherstorm

3712.name: Area 52
3712.description: Area 52 is a neutral goblin town on the southwesternmost island of Netherstorm, surrounded by a short wall and built much like Gadgetzan and Everlook, with an inn, a bank, merchants, and goblin bruisers keeping the peace. The goblins here are building a great rocket, the X-52 Nether-Rocket, meant to journey into the Twisting Nether, and they supply bombs to the forces fighting the Burning Legion in Hellfire Peninsula; their experiments fill the air with smoke and noise. Flight masters connect the town with outposts of every faction, and travelers of all races find shelter here.

3721.name: The Crumbling Waste
3721.description: The Crumbling Waste is the barren, broken area at the edge of Netherstorm, where the land crumbles away into the Twisting Nether. Rock flayers, blood elves, and nether rays roam the area, ready to attack unwary travelers.

3722.name: Manaforge Ara
3722.description: Manaforge Ara is one of the five great manaforges built by the blood elves loyal to Kael'thas to siphon energy from the Twisting Nether, located on a floating island north of Area 52. Blood elves and demons of the Burning Legion garrison it together, and conduits carry its energy toward Tempest Keep.

3723.name: Arklon Ruins
3723.description: The Arklon Ruins are the remains of a draenei settlement in southern Netherstorm, now occupied by agents of the Burning Legion, doomguards and felbeasts, who hunt for draenei artifacts of power among the broken stones.

3724.name: Cosmowrench
3724.description: Cosmowrench is a small goblin outpost in the easternmost part of Netherstorm, very close to Tempest Keep, resembling a miniature version of Area 52. It has a flight master, merchants, and goblin bruisers, and it serves travelers heading toward the great naaru fortress.

3725.name: Ruins of Enkaat
3725.description: The Ruins of Enkaat are the remains of a draenei settlement in western Netherstorm, northwest of Area 52. No one knows for certain what destroyed it, but the skeletons and crates of belongings scattered about suggest that its people were in the middle of evacuating when the end came, perhaps in the same catastrophe that tore Draenor apart. It is now haunted by the ghosts of its draenei, among them spectral vindicators who still wander the ruins.

3726.name: Manaforge B'naar
3726.description: Manaforge B'naar is one of the five great manaforges built by the blood elves loyal to Kael'thas, located west of Area 52 and visible from the Gyro-Plank Bridge. Its towers crackle with arcane energy drawn from the Nether.

3727.name: The Scrap Field
3727.description: The Scrap Field is a hill in Netherstorm covered with the remains of several destroyed fel reavers, the Burning Legion's great war machines. Demons occupy the scraps, dangerously near the Eco-Dome Midrealm.

3728.name: The Vortex Fields
3728.description: The Vortex Fields are the fields around Manaforge Duro on the central island of Netherstorm, roamed by warp stalkers and swept by arcane winds.

3729.name: The Heap
3729.description: The Heap is the remains of a destroyed fel reaver in southwestern Netherstorm, a mountain of twisted metal now occupied by hostile ethereals.

3730.name: Manaforge Coruu
3730.description: Manaforge Coruu is one of the five great manaforges built by the blood elves loyal to Kael'thas, located on the southernmost floating island of Netherstorm. It serves as the base of one of the prince's lieutenants.

3731.name: The Tempest Rift
3731.description: The Tempest Rift is the part of the Twisting Nether surrounding Tempest Keep on all sides, a swirling void of arcane energy in which the great fortress floats. The wings of the keep are bound together by unseen forces.

3732.name: Kirin'Var Village
3732.description: Kirin'Var Village is a ruined human village on the southernmost floating island of Netherstorm. When the Alliance Expedition came to Draenor, Kirin Tor wizards led by Archmage Vargoth founded it on the shore of the Devouring Sea, in the heart of the Laughing Skull clan's territory, and survived countless orc assaults. When Draenor was torn apart, the surviving wizards remained in their village for seventeen years, until the blood elves of Kael'thas destroyed it with a terrible mana bomb. The archmage and his followers fled into their tower, only for Kael'thas to seal it with a curse. Now the village is inhabited by ghosts and strange magical apparitions, divided into Wizard Row, the Town Square, the Chapel Yard, and the Violet Tower.

3733.name: The Violet Tower
3733.description: The Violet Tower is the central spire of Kirin'Var Village in Netherstorm, where the leader of the village's wizards is said to be trapped. A curse hangs over the tower, and an arcane golem guards it, while friendly ghosts linger nearby.

3734.name: Manaforge Duro
3734.description: Manaforge Duro is one of the five great manaforges built by the blood elves loyal to Kael'thas, located on the floating island directly west of Tempest Keep. It is running near full capacity, and mana creatures leak from its pipes.

3735.name: Voidwind Plateau
3735.description: Voidwind Plateau is the area surrounding the destroyed Manaforge Ultris in eastern Netherstorm, full of basilisks, oozes, and creatures of the void that poured through the tear in reality.

3736.name: Manaforge Ultris
3736.description: Manaforge Ultris is one of the five great manaforges built by the blood elves loyal to Kael'thas, located on a floating island northwest of Tempest Keep. It was run beyond its capacity and exploded, tearing a hole in the fabric of reality, and it has since been overrun by creatures of the void. Rival ethereal factions struggle over the ruin.

3737.name: Celestial Ridge
3737.description: The Celestial Ridge is a crystal-lined area of northeastern Netherstorm, home to many nether drakes and nether dragons. Great arcane crystals rise like a forest, glowing with otherworldly light.

3738.name: The Stormspire
3738.description: The Stormspire is a neutral town of the Consortium ethereals in Netherstorm, built atop a cliff of draenei ruins beneath the interconnected eco-domes of Sutheron and Skyperch, though no draenei are to be seen there now. Lush jungle vegetation grows within the domes, in sharp contrast with the purple, storm-wracked sky. It is the center of all Consortium activity in Outland, from which the ethereals mine, excavate, and trade throughout the Netherstorm; their leader, Nexus-Prince Haramad, oversees the town from his chambers at the top of the spire through a holographic image and deals with Kael'thas and the forces of Azeroth alike. The town is under constant threat from the Burning Legion's forge camps nearby.

3739.name: Forge Base: Oblivion
3739.description: Forge Base: Oblivion is one of the two great forge bases of the Burning Legion in Netherstorm, located west of Eco-Dome Sutheron. It serves primarily as an assembly base for fel reavers, and it is full of doomguards, gan'arg, and other demons.

3740.name: Forge Base: Gehenna
3740.description: Forge Base: Gehenna is one of the two great forge bases of the Burning Legion in Netherstorm. It serves as a staging ground for the Legion's attacks against the Stormspire, with teleportation devices, and it is full of wrathguards, shivarra, and mo'arg.

3741.name: Ruins of Farahlon
3741.description: The Ruins of Farahlon are the remains of a great draenei settlement in northern Netherstorm, just northeast of the Stormspire, once a major site of draenei civilization; Farahlon was also the old name of the entire region before it became the Netherstorm. A mighty dreadlord has slain the Legion's demons that dug here and claimed the ruins for himself, filling them with void hounds and beholders, and he holds a powerful draenei crystal unearthed from the ruins.

3742.name: Socrethar's Seat
3742.description: Socrethar's Seat is an entire floating island in northwestern Netherstorm, the throne of a powerful eredar commander of the Burning Legion and his demonic minions. It is reachable only by air or by magical means.

3837.name: Sunfury Hold
3837.description: Sunfury Hold is a blood elf encampment in southern Netherstorm, ruled by one of Kael'thas's lieutenants. The blood elves here are responsible for the destruction of Kirin'Var Village.

3842.name: Tempest Keep
3842.description: Tempest Keep is a vast naaru fortress floating in the Tempest Rift in eastern Netherstorm, a dimensional vessel of crystal and arcane machinery able to travel through the Twisting Nether in the blink of an eye. The naaru A'dal, M'uru, and O'ros brought it to Outland to aid its peoples against the Burning Legion, but when the naaru set out from their stronghold, Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider and his blood elves raided the fortress and seized its satellite structures, and it became his seat of power. A band of draenei hijacked a fourth satellite, the Exodar, and fled in it to Azeroth. Its three remaining wings, the Mechanar, the Botanica, and the Arcatraz, a prison holding terrible beings, float around the central Eye, and pieces of the keep were torn out to build the manaforges that now drain the Netherstorm's energies.

3850.name: Netherstone
3850.description: Netherstone is a region of crystalline spires in northern Netherstorm, between Eco-Dome Farfield and the Ruins of Farahlon, densely populated by powerful and well-camouflaged colossi. The giants are a source of a rare crystal coveted by the ethereals.

3851.name: Midrealm Post
3851.description: Midrealm Post is a very small settlement in the southeastern part of Eco-Dome Midrealm in Netherstorm, led by the Consortium, with a few goblin representatives from Area 52.

3852.name: Tuluman's Landing
3852.description: Tuluman's Landing is a small ethereal encampment on the western side of the northern floating isle of Netherstorm, a staging area for attacks on Manaforge Ara.

3854.name: Protectorate Watch Post
3854.description: The Protectorate Watch Post is the base of the Protectorate, a band of ethereals, in Netherstorm. It is located to keep watch over both the rival Ethereum and the void creatures of Manaforge Ultris, though it is understaffed and cannot attack either alone.

3868.name: Gyro-Plank Bridge
3868.description: The Gyro-Plank Bridge is a bridge built by goblins across the gap over the Twisting Nether between the Blade's Edge Mountains and Netherstorm. It is the only way to reach Netherstorm on foot, and it sways alarmingly above the void.

3873.name: The Proving Grounds
3873.description: The Proving Grounds are an area of broken plains just east of Area 52 in Netherstorm, site of a small goblin camp. They have seen many battles between the goblins and the dangers of the region.

3874.name: Eco-Dome Farfield
3874.description: Eco-Dome Farfield is the northernmost of the ethereals' eco-domes in Netherstorm, a great arcane dome preserving a lush jungle inhabited almost exclusively by raptors and a monstrous devilsaur. A deep ravine cuts through its center, and great colossi of living stone guard the land outside. The dome's generators make it a testing ground for repairing the others.

3875.name: Eco-Dome Skyperch
3875.description: Eco-Dome Skyperch is the southern part of the conjoined eco-domes at the heart of Netherstorm, connected with Sutheron. Within its arcane shield, flora and fauna thrive that could never survive in the storm outside.

3876.name: Eco-Dome Sutheron
3876.description: Eco-Dome Sutheron is the northern part of the conjoined eco-domes at the heart of Netherstorm, linked with Skyperch. Together they encase a vast area of lush vegetation inhabited by talbuks and lashers, surrounding the Stormspire.

3877.name: Eco-Dome Midrealm
3877.description: Eco-Dome Midrealm is one of the ethereals' eco-domes in Netherstorm, a great arcane dome preserving a lush jungle inhabited by crocolisks, lynxes, raptors, and moths. A small Consortium camp stands in its southeastern corner.

3878.name: Ethereum Staging Grounds
3878.description: The Ethereum Staging Grounds are a large area of the island of Manaforge Ultris in eastern Netherstorm, full of Ethereum ethereals who form a front against the nearby Protectorate.

3879.name: Chapel Yard
3879.description: The Chapel Yard is the northernmost part of the ruined Kirin'Var Village in Netherstorm, where numerous ghosts roam around the old chapel.

3880.name: Access Shaft Zeon
3880.description: Access Shaft Zeon is a mine below Manaforge Ultris in Netherstorm, littered with the corpses of slain blood elves, which hold parasitic fleshbeasts that burst out when the living come near. A ravenous creature is said to lurk deep within.

3881.name: Trelleum Mine
3881.description: Trelleum Mine is a small shaft dug into the side of the floating island beneath Manaforge Ara in Netherstorm, run by demons and overseen by blood elves. It supplies materials for running the manaforges.

3882.name: Invasion Point: Destroyer
3882.description: Invasion Point: Destroyer is a small staging ground of the Burning Legion in Netherstorm, where gan'arg engineers work. It is a source of concern for the Consortium.

3883.name: Camp of Boom
3883.description: The Camp of Boom is the hidden camp of a single crazed goblin and his numerous exploding robots, in the rocks just northeast of Area 52 in Netherstorm. Explosions frequently echo from it.

3900.name: Invasion Point: Overlord
3900.description: Invasion Point: Overlord is a small staging ground of the Burning Legion in Netherstorm, where wrathguards gather. It is a source of concern for the Consortium.

3921.name: Arklonis Ridge
3921.description: Arklonis Ridge is a crystalline hillside in southern Netherstorm, full of powerful colossi.

3934.name: Town Square
3934.description: The Town Square is the eastern part of the ruined Kirin'Var Village in Netherstorm, where numerous ghosts roam among the broken buildings.

3935.name: Wizard Row
3935.description: Wizard Row is the southernmost part of the ruined Kirin'Var Village in Netherstorm, where uncontrolled mana surges roam among the wizards' former homes.

3523.description: Netherstorm is a region of northeastern Outland consisting of several large land fragments and countless smaller shards of rock floating in the Twisting Nether, locked in a constant magical storm. It was once a verdant open range called the Fields of Farahlon, until Draenor was torn apart by Ner'zhul's portals; normally imperceptible to mortals, the Twisting Nether bled into the physical realm and unleashed a tumultuous arcane storm that warped the land. The bedrock and soil have turned a sickly purple, nothing grows save strange netherbloom, magical lightning arcs across a thick haze of violet cloud, and bands of pure energy twist across the sky. The storm is slowly tearing apart the fabric of reality, and the region is in constant decay. The blood elves loyal to Kael'thas Sunstrider have built five great manaforges using naaru technology from Tempest Keep, which they seized, to siphon energy from the Nether, making the land ever more unstable. The Burning Legion holds forge bases and invasion points across the islands. The ethereals of the Consortium have built great arcane eco-domes that preserve lush environments, centered on their town of the Stormspire, while the rival Protectorate and Ethereum struggle over a ruined manaforge. The goblins have built the town of Area 52 and the Gyro-Plank Bridge, and the ruins of draenei settlements and the human village of Kirin'Var are haunted by ghosts. Nether rays, mana wyrms, colossi, and nether drakes inhabit the shattered land.

3524.name: Azuremyst Isle

3526.name: Ammen Vale
3526.description: Ammen Vale is a small, sheltered valley in the east of Azuremyst Isle, separated from the main island by a river and surrounded by hills. It is a lightly forested land of green grass and evergreens, now scattered with escape pods, crystals, and smoking pieces of the crashed Exodar. Here many draenei survivors gathered after the crash, and young draenei begin their training under the guidance of vindicators and priests. The vale is peaceful, though some of its creatures have been mutated by the crystals' energies.

3527.name: Crash Site
3527.description: The Crash Site is the place in Ammen Vale where a large piece of the Exodar crashed onto Azuremyst Isle, shattering into tons of crystals upon impact. It has become the main gathering place for the draenei survivors in the vale, and vindicators, technicians, and teachers work tirelessly to heal the injured, maintain contact with the scattered survivors, and train the young. The shattered crystals have tainted the surrounding plants, animals, and water, and the draenei struggle to contain the damage.

3528.name: Silverline Lake
3528.description: Silverline Lake is a lake in the southeastern part of Ammen Vale on Azuremyst Isle. For centuries it was a source of pure water for the island's wildlife, but since the crash of the Exodar, a crystal shard has tainted its waters, and the creatures that drink from it are being warped and mutated. The draenei work to cleanse the lake and restore its purity.

3529.name: Nestlewood Thicket
3529.description: Nestlewood Thicket is a wooded area in southern Ammen Vale on Azuremyst Isle, home to a community of owlkin. Some of the owlkin have been mutated by the energies of the crystals that fell from the Exodar and have become hostile, while the draenei try to protect the unaffected ones from the same fate. The thicket is dense and quiet, filled with the hoots of owls.

3530.name: Shadow Ridge
3530.description: Shadow Ridge is a series of high, craggy hills in southwestern Ammen Vale on Azuremyst Isle. It has become a hiding place for blood elves who followed the draenei from Outland, the same saboteurs responsible for the crash of the Exodar. They lurk among the rocks, plotting further mischief against the draenei. The ridge offers a view over the vale below.

3559.name: Nestlewood Hills
3559.description: Nestlewood Hills are a hilly, wooded area in southern Ammen Vale on Azuremyst Isle, reached through Nestlewood Thicket or by a mountain path. Like the thicket, the hills are home to owlkin, some of whom have been mutated by the crystals of the Exodar. The hills offer a quiet, secluded corner of the vale.

3560.name: Ammen Fields
3560.description: The Ammen Fields are a small meadow in Ammen Vale on Azuremyst Isle, covered with strange purple grass and flowers and surrounded by green grass and evergreens. Fragments of the crashed Exodar lie scattered across the fields, and the plants here have been twisted into mutated root lashers by the crystals' energies. The fields are the gateway between Ammen Vale and the rest of the island.

3561.name: The Sacred Grove
3561.description: The Sacred Grove is a well-hidden glade deep in northwestern Ammen Vale, concealed by two mountains and thick trees, its entrance guarded by a spirit of the vale. Within, elementals of earth, fire, water, and air are locked in conflict with each other, and draenei shamans come here to learn the ways of the elements. The grove is a place of raw natural power.

3564.name: Emberglade
3564.description: Emberglade is an area in the northeast of Azuremyst Isle, a burned ring of trees with only a few blades of grass and stones remaining. It is inhabited by fire elementals, who are not hostile to travelers, and a powerful spirit of fire is said to dwell here, sought by shamans in their training. The air is warm and smells of ash.

3566.name: Moonwing Den
3566.description: Moonwing Den is a series of small owlkin camps on Silvermyst Isle, off the southwestern coast of Azuremyst Isle. The owlkin here have been driven mad and aggressive by the radiation from the crystals of the Exodar, and travelers should exercise caution when exploring nearby.

3567.name: Pod Cluster
3567.description: The Pod Cluster is a group of crashed escape pods from the Exodar in the woods southwest of Azure Watch on Azuremyst Isle. The pods appear to have served their purpose, and their occupants have long since moved on to Azure Watch or the Exodar itself. The empty pods, half-buried in the earth and surrounded by crystal shards, are a reminder of the draenei's desperate flight.

3568.name: Pod Wreckage
3568.description: The Pod Wreckage is a crashed escape pod from the Exodar in the woods southeast of Azure Watch on Azuremyst Isle. Its occupants have long since moved on, and the pod lies empty among the trees, surrounded by scattered crystal shards.

3569.name: Tides' Hollow
3569.description: Tides' Hollow is a damp cave on the southern coast of Azuremyst Isle, occupied by the Wrathscale naga who also hold the nearby ruins of Wrathscale Point. Despite its small opening, the cave stretches deep into the earth, and its interior is filled with ruined night elven relics and columns, suggesting that an ancient night elf settlement once stood here. The naga's lord is said to dwell deep within.

3570.name: Wrathscale Point
3570.description: Wrathscale Point is an area on the southern coast of Azuremyst Isle with a small night elven ruin overrun by the Wrathscale naga. The ruins are filled with ancient night elf relics, and the naga guard them fiercely. The sea crashes against the rocks nearby.

3571.name: Bristlelimb Village
3571.description: Bristlelimb Village is a small furbolg village on western Azuremyst Isle, home to the hostile Bristlelimb tribe. Many members of the friendly Stillpine tribe are held captive here in cages, and the two tribes are bitter enemies. The village is a crude collection of huts and totems among the trees.

3572.name: Stillpine Hold
3572.description: Stillpine Hold is the home of the Stillpine tribe of furbolgs on the northern side of Azuremyst Isle, built around a great cave in the hills. Far removed from their cousins on the mainland, the Stillpine have remained uncorrupted, and they have become friends and allies of the newly arrived draenei. Their high chief leads the tribe, and their hold is a warm, rustic place of wooden huts and totems, though the cave itself has been troubled by hostile creatures.

3573.name: Odesyus' Landing
3573.description: Odesyus' Landing is a small coastal camp on the southern shore of Azuremyst Isle, founded by an Alliance fleet that was forced to land here. It is little more than a campfire sheltered by a tall log wall, inhabited by sailors and travelers of many Alliance races, including humans, dwarves, gnomes, and night elves, who have become allies of the draenei. The camp is humble but lively, and its cook serves endless meals to the stranded crew.

3574.name: Valaar's Berth
3574.description: Valaar's Berth is a dock outside the Exodar on the western coast of Azuremyst Isle, the draenei's link to the wider world. Ships sail from here to Auberdine in Darkshore and to Stormwind, connecting the Azuremyst Isles with Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. The dock is a busy place of draenei, night elves, and travelers, and the great crystalline hull of the Exodar rises above it.

3575.name: Silting Shore
3575.description: The Silting Shore is the northwestern shoreline of Azuremyst Isle, a beach filled with murloc huts. The murlocs here are aggressive and attack anyone who wanders too close, often in groups. The sea rolls gently onto the sand, and the murlocs' gurgling cries fill the air.

3576.name: Azure Watch
3576.description: Azure Watch is a draenei settlement in the heart of Azuremyst Isle, serving as a waypoint between Ammen Vale and the Exodar. It was built by the survivors of the crash around pieces of the ship, and it has grown into a small town with teachers, merchants, a forge, and an inn. Here the draenei care for the wounded, study the effects of the crash on the island, and welcome their new allies, including night elves who are only beginning to understand that the draenei are not the eredar demons they resemble.

3577.name: Geezle's Camp
3577.description: Geezle's Camp is a small camp of the goblin Venture Company near the southeastern shoreline of Azuremyst Isle. The goblins are here to exploit the island's resources, and they are a source of much annoyance for the nearby inhabitants of Odesyus' Landing. The camp is a noisy, cluttered place of tents and machinery.

3578.name: Menagerie Wreckage
3578.description: The Menagerie Wreckage is a small area along the path to Odesyus' Landing on Azuremyst Isle, where cages from the Exodar's menagerie crashed to the ground before the ship plowed into Wildwind Peak. The creatures that escaped, including ravagers from Outland, now roam the area and threaten the island's native fauna. Crystal shards of various sizes are scattered throughout.

3579.name: Traitor's Cove
3579.description: Traitor's Cove is a deserted stretch of sand on the eastern shore of Silvermyst Isle, off the southwestern coast of Azuremyst Isle. With no plant or animal life, it is a secluded and empty place, which has made it a favorite spot for secret meetings among those who would rather not be seen.

3580.name: Wildwind Peak
3580.description: Wildwind Peak is the large and very tall mountain on western Azuremyst Isle into which the Exodar crashed. Its summit, reached by a hidden path along the shore, is watched over by air elementals, and shamans come here to commune with the spirits of the air. The peak offers a breathtaking view of the island and the sea.

3581.name: Wildwind Path
3581.description: Wildwind Path is the long and winding path that leads up to the summit of Wildwind Peak on Azuremyst Isle. It is watched over by air elementals, and strong winds sweep across it. Oddly, no crystal shards lie along the path, despite the peak being the site of the Exodar's impact.

3639.name: Silvermyst Isle
3639.description: Silvermyst Isle is a small island off the southwestern coast of Azuremyst Isle. It once held a small night elven fishing village, but when the Exodar crashed, crystal shards fell on the island and drove the local owlkin mad, and they rampaged through the village, killing most of its inhabitants. The island is now home to murlocs and maddened owlkin, and the abandoned village stands as a sad reminder of the crash's consequences.

3857.name: Ammen Ford
3857.description: Ammen Ford is a shallow crossing in the strait between Ammen Vale and the rest of Azuremyst Isle, where the water is shallow enough to wade. Fish swim in the clear water, which flows from a waterfall on a nearby mountain into the Veiled Sea. The ford is the main path between the vale and the island.

3915.name: Fairbridge Strand
3915.description: Fairbridge Strand is the stretch of shore in northern Azuremyst Isle that faces Bloodmyst Isle to the north. An ancient night elven bridge spans the strait here, connecting the two islands. Murlocs inhabit the shore and steal grain from their neighbors, the Stillpine furbolgs.

3916.name: Moongraze Woods
3916.description: Moongraze Woods is the forest surrounding Azure Watch on Azuremyst Isle, a peaceful woodland of evergreens and purple flowers. It is inhabited by roaming stags, nightstalkers, and lashers, some of which have been affected by the crystals of the Exodar. The woods are beautiful and serene.

3524.description: Azuremyst Isle is the larger of the two main islands of the Azuremyst Isles, lying off the western coast of northern Kalimdor across the Veiled Sea from Darkshore. For ages it remained largely untouched by the civilized races, home to furbolgs, owlkin, and wild beasts, with only scattered night elven ruins from before the Sundering. All that changed when the Exodar, a dimensional ship of the naaru seized by the draenei in Outland, was sabotaged during its escape and crashed onto the islands, scattering its wreckage and crystals across the land. The surviving draenei, led by the Prophet Velen, made the island their new home and built their capital within the largest intact section of the ship on the western coast. The island is a land of evergreen forests, purple flowers, and rolling hills, divided by a river into the main island and the sheltered Ammen Vale in the east, with the small Silvermyst Isle to the south. Strange crystals from the ship dot the landscape and arcane storms ripple across the sky, and the crash has tainted and mutated some of the island's plants and animals; the draenei work to heal the land. The friendly Stillpine furbolgs dwell in the north, naga lurk in ancient ruins along the coasts, murlocs inhabit the shores, and blood elf saboteurs still hide in the hills.

3525.name: Bloodmyst Isle

3583.name: Beryl Coast
3583.description: The Beryl Coast is the southern shoreline of Bloodmyst Isle, facing Azuremyst Isle across the strait. The crimson mist and the corruption of plants and animals are not as thick here as further inland, and the coast still retains some of the island's former beauty.

3584.name: Blood Watch
3584.description: Blood Watch is the main draenei settlement on Bloodmyst Isle, built around large crystal pieces of the crashed Exodar near the center of the island. It serves as the draenei's base of operations for studying and healing the corrupted land, and as a defense against the blood elves, satyrs, and naga who threaten the island. Vindicators, priests, and anchorites live and work here, and a flight path connects it with the Exodar. The settlement glows with the light of the crystals, and the crimson mist hangs in the air around it.

3585.name: Bladewood
3585.description: Bladewood is an area of Bloodmyst Isle just northwest of Blood Watch, infested with blood elves who followed the draenei from Outland. They are pumping energy from the blood crystals to empower their mysterious leader and plotting an attack on Blood Watch. The woods are tinged crimson by the corruption.

3586.name: The Vector Coil
3586.description: The Vector Coil is a massive piece of the Exodar that crashed into western Bloodmyst Isle. It has become the source of power for the blood elf invaders on the islands, who have fortified it with saboteurs and agents loyal to Kael'thas Sunstrider and are draining magical energy from its crystals. A portal nearby allows more invaders to arrive from Outland. The area is heavily tainted by the blood crystals.

3587.name: The Warp Piston
3587.description: The Warp Piston is a fallen piece of the Exodar that crash-landed on Bloodmyst Isle. It was once the site of a portal used by blood elf invaders to attack the draenei, and the area now teems with voidwalkers created by the portal's energies. The wreckage is twisted and scorched, surrounded by crystals.

3588.name: The Cryo-Core
3588.description: The Cryo-Core is a cryogenic core from the Exodar that crashed on Bloodmyst Isle. It is now being scavenged by blood elves, who steal medicines and supplies from the wreckage. The blood crystals from the core's landing have infected this part of the island, and the area is tinged with the crimson mist.

3589.name: The Crimson Reach
3589.description: The Crimson Reach is the northeastern shoreline of Bloodmyst Isle, facing Wyrmscar Island to the east and Bloodcurse Isle to the southeast. The beaches are tinged red by the corruption, and the waters are dark and murky.

3590.name: Wrathscale Lair
3590.description: Wrathscale Lair is an ancient night elven ruin cresting a hill on Bloodmyst Isle, infested by the Wrathscale naga and their leader. The area has been tainted by the blood crystals of the Exodar, like most of the island, and the naga guard their lair fiercely.

3591.name: Ruins of Loreth'Aran
3591.description: The Ruins of Loreth'Aran are the remains of a great night elven city in northeastern Bloodmyst Isle, destroyed long ago. The night elves of Loreth'Aran were blessed by the green dragonflight, and their dragon riders lived alongside the green dragons and rode them into battle, until the black dragonflight betrayed their green kin and descended upon the city in a storm of flame, wiping it out. The Sundering completed the city's destruction, scattering its remains across separate islands. The ruins are now inhabited by cursed Wrathscale naga.

3592.name: Nazzivian
3592.description: Nazzivian is an extensive satyr encampment in southwestern Bloodmyst Isle, home to the Nazzivus satyrs and corrupted treants. A monument inscribed with demonic glyphs stands among the satyrs' tents, and it is said that they summon demons here. The entire encampment has been tainted by the crash of the Exodar.

3593.name: Axxarien
3593.description: Axxarien is a satyr camp in northern Bloodmyst Isle, led by an evil satyr lord. The satyrs are trying to use the crystal shards from the Exodar's crash as weapons, and the area around their camp is heavily corrupted. The satyrs are hostile to all outsiders.

3594.name: Blacksilt Shore
3594.description: The Blacksilt Shore is a black-grained beach on southwestern Bloodmyst Isle, home to murlocs who have built huts along the shore. It faces Wyrmscar Island and Bloodcurse Isle, two other islands corrupted by the crystal shards.

3595.name: The Foul Pool
3595.description: The Foul Pool is a small tainted lake in northwestern Bloodmyst Isle, its waters corrupted by the blood crystals of the Exodar. It is populated by corrupted water elementals, and its crimson waters are poisonous to drink.

3596.name: The Hidden Reef
3596.description: The Hidden Reef is a small temple of the water elementals located deep underwater off the northwestern coast of Bloodmyst Isle. Shamans seek it out to commune with the spirits of water. The surrounding waters are tainted red by the corruption of the island.

3597.name: Amberweb Pass
3597.description: Amberweb Pass is a mountain pass on Bloodmyst Isle, north of the Vector Coil, infested with gigantic spiders. Before the crash of the Exodar, the spiders lived peacefully in the pass, but the blood crystals corrupted them, causing them to grow to monstrous size, multiply, and turn hostile. A massive spider matriarch is said to rule the pass.

3598.name: Wyrmscar Island
3598.description: Wyrmscar Island is an island northeast of Bloodmyst Isle, once part of the night elven city of Loreth'Aran, whose dragon riders lived alongside the green dragonflight. The city was destroyed when the black dragonflight descended upon it, and the island is now home to the bones of dragons, the restless spirits of slain green whelps, and the ghost of a night elf prince. It is said that the evil shade of the black dragon who led the attack still lingers, its hatred so great that it endures even in death.

3599.name: Talon Stand
3599.description: Talon Stand is a hill in the middle of Wyrmscar Island, northeast of Bloodmyst Isle. It is populated by the spirits of dragon whelps, and it is said to be the lair of the undead black dragon who destroyed Loreth'Aran. The hill is barren and haunted.

3600.name: Bristlelimb Enclave
3600.description: The Bristlelimb Enclave is a large village of the hostile Bristlelimb furbolgs on Bloodmyst Isle, just south of Wrathscale Lair. The Bristlelimb are bitter enemies of the friendly Stillpine tribe of Azuremyst, and they hold captives in their village. The enclave is a crude collection of huts and totems.

3601.name: Ragefeather Ridge
3601.description: Ragefeather Ridge is a hilly region of northeastern Bloodmyst Isle filled with owlkin camps. The owlkin here have become hostile due to the radiation from the crystal shards of the Exodar, and they attack anyone who comes near.

3602.name: Kessel's Crossing
3602.description: Kessel's Crossing is the southernmost draenei settlement on Bloodmyst Isle, a small outpost near the bridge to Azuremyst Isle. This area of the island has not yet been corrupted by the blood crystals, and it serves as a waypoint for travelers heading north into the crimson mist.

3603.name: Tel'athion's Camp
3603.description: Tel'athion's Camp is a small, abandoned camp in northwestern Bloodmyst Isle, consisting of little more than a tent lit by torches, a worktable, and barrels of tainted water. It lies along the red river south of Amberweb Pass. Its former occupant appears to have been studying the corruption of the island's waters.

3604.name: The Bloodcursed Reef
3604.description: The Bloodcursed Reef is a naga-infested area east of Wyrmscar Island, off the coast of Bloodmyst Isle. Several destroyed ships lie broken on the ocean floor, haunted by the spirits of the night elves who once sailed them. The waters are tinged red by the corruption.

3608.name: Vindicator's Rest
3608.description: Vindicator's Rest is a small draenei outpost in northwestern Bloodmyst Isle, from which the draenei launch their efforts against the blood elf invaders and the other threats of the island. It is a humble camp, surrounded by the tainted forest and the crimson mist.

3612.name: Bloodcurse Isle
3612.description: Bloodcurse Isle is a small island off the eastern coast of Bloodmyst Isle, populated by cursed naga and ruled by a naga queen. The island is tainted by the corruption of the crystals, and its waters are red and murky.

3906.name: The Bloodwash
3906.description: The Bloodwash is the northern shoreline of Bloodmyst Isle, alive with many groups of murlocs, who have erected crude huts on the beach. The waves wash onto the sand tinged red by the island's corruption.

3907.name: Veridian Point
3907.description: Veridian Point is the northern tip of Wyrmscar Island, northeast of Bloodmyst Isle, infested with the spirits of dragon whelps. The point offers a view over the sea and the ruins of Loreth'Aran.

3908.name: Middenvale
3908.description: Middenvale is a wooded area of southeastern Bloodmyst Isle, its most notable feature a pair of crashed escape pods from the Exodar. Treants, bears, and lashers roam the vale of corrupted trees, which have been tinged crimson by the blood crystals.

3909.name: The Lost Fold
3909.description: The Lost Fold is an area on Bloodmyst Isle just north of Kessel's Crossing, where broken cages, debris, and crystals from the crashing Exodar landed. Ravagers that escaped from the ship's menagerie wander the area. The crystals here have not yet corrupted the land.

3910.name: Mystwood
3910.description: Mystwood is a wooded area in southwestern Bloodmyst Isle, west of Middenvale and south of Nazzivian. Bears, lashers, and treants roam the woods, and this once peaceful grove has been entirely tainted by the crash of the Exodar, its trees and plants tinged crimson.

3525.description: Bloodmyst Isle is the second of the two main islands of the Azuremyst Isles, lying north of Azuremyst Isle off the western coast of northern Kalimdor. Once known as Silvergale and as beautiful as its southern neighbor, it was corrupted when large pieces of the crashed Exodar fell upon it, scattering blood-red crystals across the land. A blood-like liquid seeps from the crystals into the ground, tainting the soil, mutating the plants and animals, and filling the air with the eerie crimson mist that gave the island its new name; even the great pine trees have taken on a crimson tinge. The draenei have set up the outpost of Blood Watch near the center of the island to study and heal the land, and they face many threats: blood elf invaders who seek to harness the crystals' power, satyrs and naga who have long found refuge on this remote island, corrupted furbolgs, mutated spiders and owlkin, and creatures from the ship's menagerie. Ancient night elven ruins dot the island, including the remains of Loreth'Aran, a city of dragon riders destroyed long ago, and the island of Wyrmscar to the northeast is haunted by the spirits of green dragons. The southern part of the island, connected to Azuremyst by an ancient bridge, remains largely untouched by the red mist.

3537.name: Borean Tundra

4020.name: Mightstone Quarry
4020.description: Mightstone Quarry is the great quarry surrounding Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra, cut deep into the tundra by an army of peons to provide stone for the fortress's walls and towers. It has been overrun by undead nerubians, who claw their way up from below.

4021.name: Bloodspore Plains
4021.description: The Bloodspore Plains are red-colored plains in the southwestern Borean Tundra, named after the bloodspore plant that gives them their hue. Bloodspore moths pollinate the plants, and snobolds serving a cruel magnataur watch over them.

4022.name: Gammoth
4022.description: Gammoth is an area within the Bloodspore Plains in the Borean Tundra, the domain of a fearsome magnataur, a giant creature half-mammoth and half-giant, who rules over his snobold servants.

4023.name: Amber Ledge
4023.description: Amber Ledge is a cliffside overlooking the Westrift in the Borean Tundra, crowned by an old mage tower of unknown origin. The Kirin Tor have made a camp at its foot, using it as a staging area in their struggle against Malygos and the blue dragonflight, and red dragons allied with the Kirin Tor are stationed here. A ruined bridge once ran from the tower to Coldarra.

4024.name: Coldarra
4024.description: Coldarra is a large island off the western coast of the Borean Tundra, rising high above the Frozen Sea with craggy cliffs on every side. Its brittle air is colder even than the tundra, and it is always covered in snow. It is the ancestral home of Malygos the Spell-Weaver and his blue dragonflight, and at its heart lies the Nexus, from which Malygos wages his war against the mortal users of magic.

4025.name: The Westrift
4025.description: The Westrift is a fjord separating the rest of the Borean Tundra from the mountainous island of Coldarra. A broken bridge once spanned it, and its cold waters churn beneath the cliffs.

4027.name: Coast of Echoes
4027.description: The Coast of Echoes is the stretch of coast in the southern Borean Tundra between Pal'ea, Garrosh's Landing, and Echo Cove, where the wind and waves echo off the cliffs.

4028.name: Riplash Strand
4028.description: The Riplash Strand is a shoreline at the southernmost point of the Borean Tundra's mainland, dotted with ruins of an ancient night elven city. It was once held by the Riplash naga, until the merciless kvaldir invaded and took it from them.

4029.name: Riplash Ruins
4029.description: The Riplash Ruins are the remains of a great night elven city in a cluster of islands at the southern tip of the Borean Tundra, half-standing buildings among wandering icebergs. The most intact is a temple of Elune, where the naga long ago replaced the goddess's image with a statue of Queen Azshara. The kvaldir have since slaughtered most of the naga and use the ruins as a staging ground for their raids, and it is said that a monstrous kraken lies imprisoned in the waters below.

4031.name: Pal'ea
4031.description: Pal'ea is a tuskarr village in the southern Borean Tundra, its houses resembling the skeletons of beached whales and watched over by the largest stone elder of any tuskarr village. It has been overrun by the kvaldir and choked with their foul mists, and only a few of its people survived.

4032.name: Valiance Keep
4032.description: Valiance Keep is the major Alliance stronghold in the Borean Tundra, a fortified town covering two islands, with a barracks, an inn, and a harbor where the great icebreaker connecting it with Stormwind docks; the bell of the ship echoes lonely across the tundra. It is the headquarters of the Valiance Expedition and one of the Alliance's two main ports in Northrend, and its soldiers fight the Scourge, the kvaldir, and the other threats of the tundra.

4033.name: Winterfin Village
4033.description: Winterfin Village is a small murloc village on the shores north of Coldarra in the Borean Tundra. The Winterfin tribe lived here in peace until an earthquake exposed nearby caverns, releasing a deranged makrura that stole their young and bent many murlocs to its will. The survivors fled to a new camp.

4034.name: The Borean Wall
4034.description: The Borean Wall is a cliff wall separating the Borean Tundra from the frozen lake of Wintergrasp to the north.

4035.name: The Geyser Fields
4035.description: The Geyser Fields are an area of steaming geysers and hot springs in the Borean Tundra, the pools crusted with mineral deposits that turn the land pale white and bright yellow, and the air stinking of sulfur. The gnomes have built a pumping station here to extract oil for their flying machines, while strange mechanical creatures have appeared in the north and undead nerubians tunnel beneath the south.

4036.name: Fizzcrank Pumping Station
4036.description: The Fizzcrank Pumping Station is an oil platform in the Geyser Fields of the Borean Tundra, built by the gnomes of Fizzcrank Airstrip to make fuel for their flying machines. Strange mechanical parts were found in its pipes, and a mysterious machine has since caused trouble for the gnomes.

4037.name: Taunka'le Village
4037.description: Taunka'le Village is a village of the taunka, ancient cousins of the tauren, just southeast of the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra. The taunka use the steam of the hot springs to prepare hides, and their chieftain has allied his people with the Horde. The village is threatened by the Scourge from the nearby temple city.

4039.name: Coldrock Quarry
4039.description: Coldrock Quarry is a tuskarr quarry and holy site in the central Borean Tundra, where the tuskarr carve their sacred ancestor statues from the living rock and honor their deceased elders. The blue dragonflight descended upon it, slaughtered every tuskarr there, and now use its stone to craft the great surge needles that siphon magic from the land. The spirits of the slain still wander among the rocks.

4040.name: Njord's Breath Bay
4040.description: Njord's Breath Bay is a large bay south of Kaskala in the eastern Borean Tundra, with an island in its middle. The kvaldir are invading the area, but an old tuskarr elder refuses to leave his sacred altar, trusting that the spirits will answer his call.

4041.name: Kaskala
4041.description: Kaskala is a ruined tuskarr port on the eastern coast of the Borean Tundra, once the capital of the tuskarr and the greatest of their ports, until the kvaldir longships came out of the mists and the slaughter began. The survivors fled east to Unu'pe. Kaskala is home to many carved stone statues housing the spirits of long-gone tuskarr elders, and its loss weighs heavily on the tuskarr.

4042.name: Transborea
4042.description: Transborea is the snowy, Scourge-held region in the far east of the Borean Tundra, beyond the open plains, a land of ice and death.

4043.name: The Flood Plains
4043.description: The Flood Plains are a vast area south of the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra, dotted with small pools inhabited by gorlocs.

4097.name: Winterfin Caverns
4097.description: The Winterfin Caverns are a cave just behind Winterfin Village in the Borean Tundra, exposed by a landslide after an earthquake on Coldarra. A strange makrura emerged from within, stealing the murlocs' young and bending many of them to its will.

4098.name: Glimmer Bay
4098.description: Glimmer Bay is a large bay north of the Westrift in the Borean Tundra, where orcas swim in the cold waters.

4099.name: Winterfin Retreat
4099.description: Winterfin Retreat is a small murloc camp just southwest of Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra, where the surviving Winterfin murlocs fled after being driven from their village. Surprisingly, these murlocs can speak and trade with outsiders.

4101.name: Sands of Nasam
4101.description: The Sands of Nasam are a beach outside Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra, infested with undead nerubians. The sands hold ancient nerubian remains.

4103.name: Nasam's Talon
4103.description: Nasam's Talon is a small hook-shaped spit of land northwest of the Riplash Strand in the Borean Tundra, a quiet and desolate place.

4104.name: Echo Cove
4104.description: Echo Cove is a small, empty cove south of the Plains of Nasam in the Borean Tundra, where fishermen sometimes come to cast their lines.

4105.name: Beryl Point
4105.description: Beryl Point is an outpost of the blue dragonflight just southwest of Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra, where dragonkin mage hunters and their human accomplices imprison spellcasters captured during the Nexus War in arcane prisons floating above glowing blue stone circles.

4106.name: Garrosh's Landing
4106.description: Garrosh's Landing is a dock area on the western shore of the Borean Tundra near Warsong Hold, where an orcish destroyer is moored and the wreck of another lies nearby. Named after Garrosh Hellscream, who led the Horde fleet that landed here, it served as the Horde's first port before the fortress was built inland. The kvaldir have since attacked it.

4107.name: Warsong Jetty
4107.description: The Warsong Jetty is a jetty on the western coast of the Borean Tundra, just south of Garrosh's Landing. At its end stands an empty Horde watchtower.

4108.name: Fizzcrank Airstrip
4108.description: Fizzcrank Airstrip is a gnomish base in the northern Borean Tundra, overlooking the Geyser Fields and its pools of stinking, boiling water. It rings with the sound of hammers from morning to night, often drowned out by the gnomes' flying machines taking off. The gnomes chose the site to launch reconnaissance flights and to scavenge parts from a nearby crashed necropolis.

4109.name: Lake Kum'uya
4109.description: Lake Kum'uya is a lake southeast of Amber Ledge in the central Borean Tundra, its waters cold and clear.

4111.name: Farshire
4111.description: Farshire is a small farming town outside Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra, whose farmers cut their fields into the rich black soil and dug a mine into the nearby hills to supply the keep with food and ore. The Scourge struck the town with plague and fire, and only the town hall and the lighthouse remain intact, while ghouls roam the fields.

4112.name: Farshire Lighthouse
4112.description: The Farshire Lighthouse stands on a promontory near Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra, warning ships away from the treacherous rocks and small icebergs that choke the harbor.

4113.name: Unu'pe
4113.description: Unu'pe is a small tuskarr port village on the eastern coast of the Borean Tundra, the main tuskarr settlement in the region since the destruction of Kaskala and Pal'ea. Its tuskarr offer boat passage to Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight, and its people are warm and welcoming despite their losses.

4114.name: Death's Stand
4114.description: Death's Stand is an encampment of the Valiance Expedition near the Wailing Ziggurat in the Borean Tundra, led by a death knight who has turned against the Lich King. From here, the death knight's unit strikes against the Scourge of En'kilah.

4115.name: The Abandoned Reach
4115.description: The Abandoned Reach is a stretch of sand east of the Farshire Lighthouse in the Borean Tundra, held by pirates and mercenaries.

4116.name: Scalding Pools
4116.description: The Scalding Pools are a series of boiling hot springs in the Borean Tundra, east of the Geyser Fields, their waters bubbling and steaming and their edges crusted with minerals.

4117.name: Steam Springs
4117.description: The Steam Springs are hot springs west of Taunka'le Village and east of the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra, filled with steam elementals and clouded with vapor.

4118.name: Talramas
4118.description: Talramas is a Scourge necropolis that crashed near the Festering Pools in the Borean Tundra due to a malfunction. Its lich commander drives his minions to make it airborne again, and the undead swarm around the wreck.

4119.name: Festering Pools
4119.description: The Festering Pools are an area once part of the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra, now overrun by the Scourge from the crashed necropolis of Talramas. The water has strangely vanished, and the stench of the undead fills the air.

4120.name: The Nexus
4120.description: The Nexus is the great fortress of the blue dragonflight on the island of Coldarra off the Borean Tundra, the seat of Malygos the Spell-Weaver, Aspect of Magic. From here, Malygos wages his Nexus War, seeking to wrest control of the world's magic from mortal hands, and great ley line energies are drawn into the Nexus. Floating rings of arcane platforms, known as the Oculus, orbit above it. The fortress is a place of cold crystal and raw magical power.

4121.name: Transitus Shield
4121.description: The Transitus Shield is a Kirin Tor outpost on the edge of Coldarra, protected by a reflective magical shield that hides it from the blue dragonflight. From here, the mages of Dalaran watch the Nexus and plan their struggle against Malygos.

4122.name: Bor'gorok Outpost
4122.description: Bor'gorok Outpost is a Horde outpost in the northern Borean Tundra, south of the entrance to Sholazar Basin. Its warriors watch over the northern plains and the elementals that rage nearby.

4123.name: Magmoth
4123.description: Magmoth is an area east of Bor'gorok Outpost and north of Fizzcrank Airstrip in the Borean Tundra, the home of a powerful magnataur, his herd, and the snobolds that serve him.

4124.name: The Dens of Dying
4124.description: The Dens of Dying are two caves in the northeastern Borean Tundra, east of Talramas, sacred to the magnataur, who come here in their old age to die.

4125.name: Temple City of En'kilah
4125.description: The Temple City of En'kilah is a Scourge fortress in the northeastern corner of the Borean Tundra, a plagued nerubian city of decay and darkness behind stone walls. Ziggurats and spires rise within it, where dark priests perform their rites, and above it floats the necropolis of Naxxanar, the command center of the Scourge in the tundra.

4126.name: The Wailing Ziggurat
4126.description: The Wailing Ziggurat is a Scourge ziggurat south of the Temple City of En'kilah in the Borean Tundra, the target of the Valiance Expedition's death knights in their struggle against the Scourge.

4127.name: Steeljaw's Caravan
4127.description: Steeljaw's Caravan is the wreck of a Horde caravan in the northern Borean Tundra, south of Bor'gorok Outpost, which attempted to cross a sacred taunka burial ground. Its leader perished, and the disturbed spirits of the taunka now haunt the area.

4128.name: Naxxanar
4128.description: Naxxanar is a Scourge necropolis floating above the Temple City of En'kilah in the Borean Tundra, the command post of the Scourge in the region, ruled by a San'layn prince. Its dark halls are guarded by undead and accessible only by those who know the words to enter.

4129.name: Warsong Hold
4129.description: Warsong Hold is the headquarters of the Horde's Warsong Offensive in Northrend, a great, spiky fortress in the southern Borean Tundra built of stone cut from the surrounding quarry. It is commanded by Garrosh Hellscream, son of Grom Hellscream, and its warriors march from here against the Scourge. Zeppelins connect it with Orgrimmar, and its halls are filled with the clamor of war.

4130.name: Plains of Nasam
4130.description: The Plains of Nasam are a region of the Borean Tundra southwest of Warsong Hold, where the Scourge has raised plague spreaders that poison the land. Skeletons, ghouls, and abominations gather here, and it is whispered that a great lieutenant of the Lich King has been seen among them.

4132.name: Ruins of Eldra'nath
4132.description: The Ruins of Eldra'nath are ancient night elven ruins in the northern Borean Tundra, west of Bor'gorok Outpost, now inhabited by enraged air elementals caught up in the war between the fire and water elementals nearby.

4133.name: Charred Rise
4133.description: The Charred Rise is an area south of Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra, home to fire elementals locked in a war with the water elementals of a nearby pool. The ground is scorched and smoking.

4134.name: Blistering Pool
4134.description: The Blistering Pool is a pool west of Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra, home to water elementals besieged by the fire elementals of the Charred Rise.

4135.name: Spire of Blood
4135.description: The Spire of Blood is a ziggurat inside the Temple City of En'kilah in the Borean Tundra, where a San'layn priest performs dark rites for the Scourge.

4136.name: Spire of Decay
4136.description: The Spire of Decay is a ziggurat inside the Temple City of En'kilah in the Borean Tundra, where a crypt lord priest feeds on the energies of surrounding necromancers.

4137.name: Spire of Pain
4137.description: The Spire of Pain is a ziggurat inside the Temple City of En'kilah in the Borean Tundra, where a crypt fiend priest performs dark rites surrounded by its kin.

4138.name: Frozen Reach
4138.description: The Frozen Reach is a vast icy area in the eastern Borean Tundra, between Unu'pe and the Wailing Ziggurat, bitterly cold and wind-swept.

4141.name: Torp's Farm
4141.description: Torp's Farm was a pig farm supplying Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra, part of a village built to house the peons working on the fortress. It now lies in ruin from Scourge attacks.

4142.name: Warsong Granary
4142.description: The Warsong Granary was a granary supplying Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. It now lies in ruin from Scourge attacks.

4143.name: Warsong Slaughterhouse
4143.description: The Warsong Slaughterhouse was a slaughterhouse supplying Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. It now lies in ruin from Scourge attacks.

4144.name: Warsong Farms Outpost
4144.description: The Warsong Farms Outpost is an outpost hastily built after the Scourge overran the farms just west of Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra, where Horde warriors hold the line.

4145.name: West Point Station
4145.description: West Point Station is a gnomish pumping station just east of Fizzcrank Airstrip among the Scalding Pools of the Borean Tundra.

4146.name: North Point Station
4146.description: North Point Station is a gnomish pumping station north of the Fizzcrank Pumping Station in the Geyser Fields of the Borean Tundra.

4147.name: Mid Point Station
4147.description: Mid Point Station is a gnomish pumping station in the shadow of the Fizzcrank Pumping Station in the middle of the Geyser Fields of the Borean Tundra.

4148.name: South Point Station
4148.description: South Point Station is a gnomish pumping station just south of the Fizzcrank Pumping Station in the Geyser Fields of the Borean Tundra.

4149.name: D.E.H.T.A. Encampment
